sentences.text: Android is a mobile operating system developed by Google , based on the Linux kernel and designed primarily for touchscreen mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets .	Google	Google	Linux kernel	Linux kernel	mobile operating system	mobile operating system	touchscreen	touchscreen	tablets	tablet computer

Android 's user interface is mainly based on direct manipulation , using touch gestures that loosely correspond to real-world actions , such as swiping , tapping and pinching , to manipulate on-screen objects , along with a virtual keyboard for text input .	user interface	user interface	direct manipulation	Direct manipulation interface	virtual keyboard	virtual keyboard

In addition to touchscreen devices , Google has further developed Android TV for televisions , Android Auto for cars , and Android Wear for wrist watches , each with a specialized user interface .	Google	Google	Android TV	Android TV	Android Auto	Android Auto	Android Wear	Android Wear	touchscreen	touchscreen	user interface	user interface
Variants of Android are also used on notebooks , game consoles , digital cameras , and other electronics .	notebooks	Laptop	game consoles	Video game console

Initially developed by Android Inc. , which Google bought in 2005 , Android was unveiled in 2007 , along with the founding of the Open Handset Alliancea consortium of hardware , software , and telecommunication companies devoted to advancing open standards for mobile devices .	Google	Google	hardware	computer hardware	software	software

Beginning with the first commercial Android device in September 2008 , the operating system has gone through multiple major releases , with the current version being 7.0 `` Nougat '' , released in August 2016 .	first commercial Android device	HTC Dream

Android applications -LRB- `` apps '' -RRB- can be downloaded from the Google Play store , which features over 2.7 million apps as of February 2017 .	Google	Google	Google Play	Google Play	apps	Mobile app
Android has been the best-selling OS on tablets since 2013 , and runs on the vast majority of smartphones .	tablets	tablet computer
, Android has two billion monthly active users , and it has the largest installed base of any operating system .	installed base	installed base

Android 's source code is released by Google under an open source license , although most Android devices ultimately ship with a combination of free and open source and proprietary software , including proprietary software required for accessing Google services .	Google	Google	proprietary	Proprietary software	software	software	source code	source code	open source license	open source license	free and open source	Free and open source software
Android is popular with technology companies that require a ready-made , low-cost and customizable operating system for high-tech devices .	high-tech	high-tech

Its open nature has encouraged a large community of developers and enthusiasts to use the open-source code as a foundation for community-driven projects , which deliver updates to older devices , add new features for advanced users or bring Android to devices originally shipped with other operating systems .	source code	source code

The extensive variation of hardware in Android devices causes significant delays for software upgrades , with new versions of the operating system and security patches typically taking months before reaching consumers , or sometimes not at all .	hardware	computer hardware	software	software	security patches	Patch (computing)

The success of Android has made it a target for patent and copyright litigation as part of the so-called `` smartphone wars '' between technology companies .	smartphone	smartphone	smartphone wars	Smartphone patent wars
